thread:
maya (AE): Hey team — customer 'NorthBridge' wants a 6-week POC. Goal: integrate Redwood API for assistive search + summarization. Need to confirm success criteria, SE coverage, and pricing ask from procurement. Who can own which piece?

sam (SE): I can own infra + model wiring. Need sample prompts and 50 eval prompts from customer. ETA to onboard model variant: ~10 business days.

lena (Solutions Eng): I'll own prompts/evals with customer. Can we ask for 2-3 representative production queries and expected quality thresholds (recall/precision or qualitative pass/fail)?

maya (AE): Procurement asked for estimated monthly committed spend if POC scales to 10k queries/day. We should give a conservative run-rate and a POC discount. Aaron, can you sketch cost profile?

aaron (Eng): Quick note — cost depends heavily on batching & KV cache usage. Rough estimate: small model endpoint ~ $0.02/query with optimizations. For 10k q/day that's ~ $200/day -> $6k/mo. I'll prepare a spreadsheet.

katie (CS): From CS side, success is adoption in 2 flows: (1) search assist and (2) multi-doc summarize. Success metric: >70% of sampled responses rated useful by SMEs, and end-to-end latency <1s P50 for search prompts.

lena (Solutions Eng): Request for security questionnaire in parallel. Customer is in healthcare; they need data isolation + SOC2 + data retention controls. sec-bot, can you attach the standard answers?

sec-bot: Attaching SQA bundle v3.2 (SOC2: yes, encryption-at-rest: yes, KMS options listed). See link: https://redwood.internal/sqa/bundles/3.2

maya (AE): Timeline proposal: Week 0: SOW + security signoff, Week 1-2: infra + model onboarding, Week 3: prompt tuning + evals, Week 4: integration testing, Week 5: customer validation, Week 6: success review & handover. Thoughts?

lena (Solutions Eng): Looks good. Suggest we add a canary day (mid-week 4) with a rollback plan and test prompts. Also need availability from customer SMEs during week 5.

sam (SE): Resource ask: 0.5 FTE for infra/setup (me), 1 full-day of eng support during canary, and 1 day of help from eng on model troubleshooting. Confirming I'll block that time.

maya (AE): Noted. SE staffing approved. I'll reflect in SOW: "SE support: 3 full days across POC".

aaron (Eng): One technical blocker flagged: customer uses a heavy prompt with long context windows (5k tokens). We'll need to test cost & latency at that length. If too slow, fallback to chunked summarize flow.

lena (Solutions Eng): For evals, we'll use 200 prompts split: 50 search, 50 summarize, 100 edge-cases. We'll capture pass/fail and freeform notes. Can the customer provide the data set by EOD Thursday?

maya (AE): I'll push on that with the customer today. Also procurement wants a POC pricing cap. Proposed: $10k cap for the 6-week POC including SE hours. Agree?

aaron (Eng): $10k seems fine as cap, add line item for extra eng days at $X/day if needed.

sam (SE): :thumbsup: Agree. One more ask: need a temporary API key and dedicated model instance to avoid noisy neighbors. Is that doable for Private/Dedicated?

maya (AE): Customer prefers hosted but wants data isolation. We'll propose Dedicated trial for the POC. I'll add to SOW.

lena (Solutions Eng): Final checklist before SOW: security bundle signed, SME contact list, eval prompts, initial dataset, SE schedule.

maya (AE): I'll compile checklist and share SOW draft by EOD. Thanks everyone.

katie (CS): I'll schedule customer validation session for week 5 and send calendar invites once SOW signed.

maya (AE): Follow-up action items:
```
- maya: SOW + pricing cap draft (due EOD)
- lena: eval template + prompt guide (due in 3 business days)
- sam: infra plan + resource calendar (due in 2 business days)
- aaron: cost spreadsheet + long-context perf notes (due in 3 business days)
- customer: dataset + 50 eval prompts (requested by Thu)
- katie: validation session invite (after SOW)
```

maya (AE): Closing thread — will post updated SOW link here when ready. :rocket:
